caption:
Google appears to be removing the one-tap Call button from many mobile map-pack results.

Early 2026 local-SEO reports describe it missing from a growing share of searches, with no official announcement and no opt-out. Website and Directions buttons route people deeper into your profile before a phone number shows.

Fewer impulse calls. More taps before someone reaches you. Urgent jobs lose the most, since that extra step is real friction when someone needs help.

Test it tonight. Open Google in incognito on your phone, search your own business name, and check your listing. If the Call button is gone, your Website button is now your fastest path to a lead.

A static contact page can't catch that click. A booking funnel that texts the lead back in under a minute can.
